author: Azrael246
quote: After getting the platinum trophy and sinking over 50+ hours into this game, I can say hands down that this is a masterpiece. The story, music, gameplay...just everything all around is absolute game of the year material. I cannot emphasize how much I loved this game and I highly recommend everyone experience Expedition 33.

author: Azrael246
quote: I am a few hours in and I'm very dissapointed. This feels more like real life than a video game in all the worst ways. Specifically, the constant having to keep up with working out, sleeping, eating, putting gas in the car, maintaining a car, chores, etc. Add on top of that having to maintain a relationship with Lucia and I am so checked out. I play video games to escape from life and to have fun. Sadly, this ain't it chief. Also, the 30 fps s u c k s balls along with the lack of a physical disc. 0 out of 10 do not recommend.

author: Azrael246
quote: Final  Fantasy 16 is the first game in a long time where I have consistently found myself in awe of what I was witnessing on the screen in front of me. I have been having so much fun experiencing Clive's story and cannot express how amazing the storytelling is. The pacing is well done and rarely feels dull. The music is an absolute banger and a masterpiece unto itself. I recommend this game wholeheartedly, you won't be disappointed.

author: Azrael246
quote: Just finished this game yesterday and I gotta say, it's probably my favorite game so far in 2022. The atmosphere, music, and gameplay is terrific and it feels like a lived in world. There were many unexpected twists and turns throughout the game and I loved the exploration aspect that came from being a cat. I highly recommend this game to anyone and everyone who wants a nice, relaxing experience that doesn't demand or expect much from you.

author: Azrael246
quote: GTA 3 is a complete disappointment and disaster. Do not bother playing it until they patch it. Vice City is a little bit better, but still has some bugs and glitches. Also really disappointed in the number of tracks that were removed from the original. San Andreas is at the very least playable and enjoyable of the 3.

author: Azrael246
quote: I'm halfway through the game and have avoided any spoilers that happen later on, but after devoting many hours to this game I can say that I am extremely disheartened by this game. I don't get excited to play this game, much like I did with the first one. It feels more like a chore to play this game in my opinion. The   pacing is atrocious. The character development is garbage. Do not recommend at all.
